body:
Clarification from the user who raised this: the real scenario is **a photo of the invoice sent to the AI in a chat app**. There the client has no bytes to forward, so option B does not help this user at all; only A (one link, several photos picked from the phone album at once) reduces their steps. This strengthens the recommendation for A and leaves B for agents with local file access only.

Not yet measured: a phone photo (JPEG) through the link (the PDF path is measured). The field's `accept` list has no `.heic`; iOS usually converts to JPEG when a browser file input picks from Photos, but that is unverified here.
